subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
1.
CA Rajesh had considered all the factors affecting the supervision and review
of engagement team members' work. One of the following is not a factor in
deciding the nature, timing and extent of the direction and supervision of
engagement team members and review of their work.
(A)  Size and complexity of the entity
(B)  The availability of time and trained personnel to review the work
(C)  The capability and competence of the individual team members
performing the audit work
(D)  The area of the audit
(2 Marks)
